newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$1.3 bln bonds due 2027.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$1.3 bln bonds due 2027.

text.p: The Government of Canada said on Thursday it plans to auction on July 23 C$1.3 billion of bonds with a coupon of 8 percent and maturing on June 1, 2027.
The Bank of Canada will buy a minimum of C$195 million of the new bonds. The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on August 1, pay interest on December 1 and June 1.
Proceeds of the issue will be used for general purposes. The government said there were no marketable bonds maturing on August 1.
The government said the new bonds are in addition to C$7.1 billion bonds due June 1, 2027, already outstanding.
